In the land of Mordor, the dreaded fortress of Barad-dûr has a basement and 19 above-ground floors. Every week, a group of 7 trolls meet in the basement for an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting. Afterward, they board the elevator, and they each randomly select one of the above-ground floors to visit, independently of one another. Multiple trolls might select the same floor.

Compute the probability that...

a. no two passengers share a floor;
a. exactly two passengers share a floor;
a. at least two passengers share a floor;
a. all passengers get off below floor 10.
